summary: BOLD holds the genetic route end to end: specimen records with genus, species and COI-5P sequence (confirmed on a downloaded TSV header and first row; 17,911,975 insect specimens, 986,808 species-name entries, 49,676 Drosophila specimens), from which species counts per genus and pairwise distances can be computed. Morphological routes are weaker: TRY is plants only and behind request/registration, MorphoSource holds scans not distance tables, AVONET covers birds only.
next_step: Pre-register a BOLD extraction for a set of insect and plant genera (barcodes per species, BIN-level cleaning), with genus richness taken from a frozen taxonomy and genus age from Open Tree to address the oversplitting and age confounds.
obstacles_confirmed: Species counts per genus in BOLD include provisional 'sp.' names.
The BOLD query response reported extent_limit 1000; what that means for large downloads was not tested.
Taxonomic splitting practice cannot be removed from the data.
